class.name: TerrainLayer
class.brief_description: A single paintable ground material inside a [Landscape3D].
class.description: [TerrainLayer] describes one ground material a [Landscape3D]'s Paint brush can blend in: an albedo texture and tint, an optional normal map, an optional packed occlusion/roughness/metallic ([member orm_texture]) map with scalar tweaks on top of it, a specular value, an optional heightmap for Parallax Occlusion Mapping (see [member Landscape3D.pom_enabled]), and how large one texture tile is in world space ([member uv_scale]). This resource is pure configuration; it does not store where it is painted (see [TerrainData]'s per-layer weight maps and [method Landscape3D.paint_layer]). [Landscape3D] combines every layer's textures into shared [Texture2DArray]s and blends any number of layers together smoothly at each point of the terrain, weighted by how much of each layer is painted there. Layer textures are resampled to a common size when built into those arrays, so very high-resolution source textures do not need to match each other exactly.

members.member: Multiplies [member albedo_texture] (or, with none assigned, is the layer's flat color), the same convention as [member BaseMaterial3D.albedo_color].
The base color texture for this layer. Until this is set, the layer renders as a flat color (see [member albedo_color]).
Multiplies [member orm_texture]'s occlusion (red) channel. Lower values weaken the baked ambient occlusion this layer contributes.

An optional grayscale heightmap for this layer, used only when [member Landscape3D.pom_enabled] is [code]true[/code] on the [Landscape3D] this layer is painted on (see its description). Brighter areas sit higher (less depth); if unset, this layer is unaffected by Parallax Occlusion Mapping even while it's enabled.

Scales how much apparent depth [member height_texture] produces under Parallax Occlusion Mapping. Matches [member BaseMaterial3D.heightmap_scale]'s range and usable values (internally scaled down for convenience, so typical values are small double-digit numbers, not fractions).
A display name for this layer, shown in [Landscape3D]'s Paint brush layer list.
An optional tangent-space normal map for this layer. If unset, the layer uses a flat normal (no extra surface detail beyond the terrain's own geometry).

An optional packed occlusion (red channel), roughness (green channel), and metallic (blue channel) texture for this layer, matching the convention used elsewhere in Godot (see [member BaseMaterial3D.orm_texture]). If unset, the layer uses full occlusion, medium roughness, and no metallic before [member ao_strength]/[member roughness] are applied.
Multiplies [member orm_texture]'s roughness (green) channel, the same convention as [member BaseMaterial3D.roughness].

Specular reflectance for this layer at normal incidence, for non-metallic (dielectric) surfaces; unrelated to [member orm_texture], which has no specular channel. Matches [member BaseMaterial3D.metallic_specular] - the default of [code]0.5[/code] is a reasonable value for most materials.
The size, in meters, that one tile of this layer's textures covers on the terrain. Smaller values tile the texture more densely (a smaller, more repeated pattern); larger values stretch it further.
